declarations.description:
Two panels separated by a draggable divider — an editor beside its preview, a list beside the record it opens, a
sidebar the reader can widen. The divider follows the WAI-ARIA window splitter pattern: it is a focusable
`separator` whose value is the size of the start panel, moved by dragging (mouse, touch or pen) or with the keyboard
(Arrow keys by 1%, Shift + Arrow by 10%, Home/End to `min`/`max`, Enter to collapse the start panel to `min` and
restore it).

`position` is the start panel's share of the space, in percent. `orientation="vertical"` stacks the panels top and
bottom; the host then needs a height. `min`/`max` bound the position, `snap` lists positions the divider sticks to
while dragging, and `primary` names the panel that keeps its pixel size when the host is resized — a sidebar that
should stay 240px wide while the window grows. Nest a second split panel in a slot for a three-way layout.
declarations.name: SplitPanel

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the visible divider line; it takes that much room between the panels.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-panel__divider--size

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the invisible grab area centred on the divider.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-panel__divider--hit-area

cssProperties.description: `none` hides the grip, leaving a bare line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-panel__handle--display

cssParts.description: Panel wrapping the `start` slot; sized by `position` and scrolls its assigned content.
cssParts.name: start

cssParts.description: Panel wrapping the `end` slot; takes the remaining space and scrolls its assigned content.
cssParts.name: end

cssParts.description: The draggable separator between the panels.
cssParts.name: divider

cssParts.description: Grip box in the middle of the divider, wrapping the `handle` slot; shows the default dot grip as fallback until content is assigned.
cssParts.name: handle

slots.description: Content of the first panel (left, or top when vertical; right in a right-to-left context).
slots.name: start

slots.description: Replaces the default grip drawn in the middle of the divider.
slots.name: handle

members.name: position
members.description: Size of the start panel in percent of the space the two panels share, clamped to `min`/`max`.

members.name: orientation
members.description: `horizontal` puts the panels side by side; `vertical` stacks them.

members.name: primary
members.description: Panel that keeps its pixel size when the host is resized. Without it both panels scale with the host.

members.name: snap
members.description: Space-separated positions in percent (`"25 50 75"`) the divider snaps to while dragging within `snap-threshold`.

members.name: snapThreshold
members.description: Distance in pixels within which a drag snaps to a `snap` position.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Locks the divider: no dragging, no keyboard, not focusable.

members.name: availableSize
members.description: Pixels the two panels share: the container along the split axis minus the divider.

events.name: reposition
events.description: Fired when the user moves the divider (drag, keyboard). Not fired for `position` changes made by script or by `primary` on resize. Does not bubble.
